It supports Tamil logical prose while OpenLogic supplies the exact formal relations. Passage hash identifies the canonical structured passage record.

authorities_checked.citation: Welton, J.; Monahan, W.; fourth edition revised by S. H. Mellone. இடைநிலை அளவையியல். Government of Ceylon. First Tamil edition, 1967. https://noolaham.org/wiki/index.php/இடைநிலை_அளவையியல்.
authorities_checked.locator: Chapter 23, முடிவு மேற்கோள், discussion of assumptions and proof
authorities_checked.note: Distinguishes what requires proof from an assumption temporarily accepted for reasoning and warns against circular proof. This supports the proof/assumption distinction, not any particular modern formal calculus. Passage hash identifies the canonical structured passage record.

authorities_checked.citation: அ.கி. மூர்த்தி. அறிவியல் வினா - விடை: கணக்கு. மணிவாசகர் பதிப்பகம். First edition December 2002. https://www.tamilvu.org/library/nationalized/pdf/72-a.k.moorthy/007.ariviyalvinaviday-kanitham.pdf.
authorities_checked.note: Presents logic as a branch of philosophy and discusses symbolic logic and reasoning. Supports தருக்கம் in formal mathematical context, without supplying modern completeness/soundness terminology. Passage hash identifies the canonical structured passage record.

decisions.intended_sense: The logic original attests எடுகூற்று, முடிபு and எடுகோள்; current SCERT attests கருதுகோள் and முடிவு for a conditional. The edition uses முன்கோள் for an argument premise, முடிவு for its conclusion, எடுகோள் for a temporary formal assumption, and defines discharge as ending that assumption's formal scope.
decisions.rationale: The logic original attests எடுகூற்று, முடிபு and எடுகோள்; current SCERT attests கருதுகோள் and முடிவு for a conditional.
